content.text: Summary: Looked at ticket T-6003, listed pods in the `warehouse` namespace, and found the 14:15 stock-sync Pod still Running after ~19h with its SFTP download stalled at 11.2/38.4 MB. Because the CronJob uses `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` and has no `activeDeadlineSeconds`, all later scheduled runs have been skipped — matching the "stock stopped updating at ~14:00" symptom. Resolved the ticket with the cause, evidence, and a two-step fix (delete the hung Job now, add `activeDeadlineSeconds` to the CronJob template to prevent recurrence), citing the CronJob concurrency and Job termination docs.
